Quest information[edit]

Objectives[edit]

  • Escort Master Togo to the edge of the Unwaking Waters.
  • Speak with Attis to gain access to the Unwaking Waters.
  • See Elder Oxis for your reward.

Reward[edit]

  • 4,000 Experience
  • 1,250 Luxon Faction
  • 150 Gold
  • 1 Skill Point

Walkthrough[edit]

Travel through Silent Surf from Leviathan Pits to Unwaking Waters. All you need to do is make sure Master Togo survives (else the quest fails and must be restarted). Be alert to the movements of various mobs, including those in the distance, as most have wide patrol routes and can easily join aggro while you're busy dispatching another mob.

NPCs[edit]

Allies[edit]

Human

  • 20 Master Togo

Dialogue[edit]

Initial dialogue[edit]

Petras
"This is an unprecedented action: Luxons and Kurzicks fighting side-by-side, allied with the empire against an evil so great it has erased all boundaries between us. You must travel into the depths of the Unwaking Waters, and at the heart of this great whirlpool, find the Harvest Temple, Kuan Jun, which has been imprisoned in jade these two hundred years. There you will obtain the power that will help us send Shiro back to the Underworld."
 Accept: "Let's do this."
 Decline: "I'm not ready."
 Ask: "You must travel to the great whirlpool to meet with Mhenlo and the Kurzicks. There I pray we will find the knowledge to defeat Shiro."

Master Togo: "Kuan Jun Temple is locked deep within the jade whirlpool. I do not know what awaits us between here and there, but I fear our journey will not be easy."
Master Togo: "Shiro's influence is strong in this place...I expect we will face tremendous resistance in our attempt to reach the temple."
Attis: "Master Togo! It has been far too long since you have been this deep in Luxon territory. Welcome."

Reward dialogue[edit]

Elder Oxis
"Truly it is the combined strength of those here with you that makes this possible. Perhaps the warring between our two peoples will continue once this is all said and done, but at least for the moment we can unite behind a cause that is just. Hurry to Mhenlo and the Kurzicks!"

Trivia[edit]

  • The name of this quest along with Into the Whirlpool is likely a referance to the memoirs of Yevgenia Ginzburg, Journey into the Whirlwind
